raw_transcript: Ah, for this invented family cooking night, my cousin Imani Cove and I made lentil stew. We used 300 g of dry lentils and 1.5 L of water. I set the timer for 25 minutes, no wait, 35 minutes; the first setting was too short. We added lemon after cooking and left the salt out of one small portion. The batch filled 6 containers, and 2 went into the freezer. Imani liked the texture, but I thought it needed more cumin. That is just taste, not a recipe failure. The ingredients cost around 12 dollars in total because some spices were already in the cupboard. I should label the frozen portions before I forget what they are.
